user_direction.scope: LLM is the semantic execution engine; expectation is research direction, not scientific evidence.

conceptual_delta: Use pretrained LLM semantics and in-context adaptation inside the existing role/context-conditioned disposition; formalize observational/action/revision contracts without hand-defining all meaning.

sources.title: Verbalized Machine Learning: Revisiting Machine Learning with Language Models
sources.authors: Tim Z. Xiao; Robert Bamler; Bernhard Schölkopf; Weiyang Liu
sources.reported_result: Natural-language parameters are executed by a frozen LLM and revised from predictions and labels by an LLM optimizer.
sources.assumptions: Task labels, prompts, model and context; reported numerical error and optimization variance.
sources.claim_ceiling: No general convergence or faithful internal-explanation theorem.

sources.title: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
sources.authors: Yan Zhang; Shikan Lian; Shibo Li
sources.reported_result: Multiple verbal hypotheses are proposed and revised by an LLM; small benchmark gains.
sources.assumptions: Externally defined label loss; fixed small benchmarks; black-box proposal density unavailable.
sources.claim_ceiling: MH drops prior/proposal ratios; SMC lacks incremental ratios. Exact posterior/invariance is not established.

sources.title: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
sources.reported_result: LLM priors generate POMDP code refined using observation-action trajectories; semantic masking ablation reduces performance.
sources.assumptions: Given state/action/observation API, chosen trajectories and observation distance; MiniGrid only.
sources.claim_ceiling: Code execution is not the same realization as recurrent LLM semantic interpretation; no latent-ontology or causal-credit theorem.

sources.title: An Explanation of In-context Learning as Implicit Bayesian Inference
sources.authors: Sang Michael Xie; Aditi Raghunathan; Percy Liang; Tengyu Ma
sources.reported_result: An exact pretraining-distribution predictor asymptotically reaches prompt Bayes-optimal risk under distinguishability.
sources.assumptions: Latent HMM concepts, regularity/delimiters, KL separation overcoming distribution mismatch; asymptotic examples.
sources.claim_ceiling: Not a theorem of arbitrary pretrained LLMs, action grounding or persistent learning.

sources.title: Transformers Learn In-Context by Gradient Descent
sources.reported_result: A linear self-attention layer has weights implementing a gradient step in linear regression.
sources.assumptions: Specified continuous regression encoding and constructed weights; empirical trained models in controlled tasks.
sources.claim_ceiling: Expressibility does not establish real-model learning, semantic identification or repeated stability.

sources.title: In-Context Learning Is Provably Bayesian Inference: A Generalization Theory for Meta-Learning
sources.reported_result: Squared risk splits into Bayes Gap and Posterior Variance; uniform-attention class has a finite-sample gap bound.
sources.assumptions: Specified meta-distribution; conditionally IID examples; bounded domains, regularity/Hölder assumptions, ERM and uniform attention.
sources.claim_ceiling: Bound does not cover arbitrary softmax LLM, active or drifting histories; reported theorem not independently formalized here.

sources.title: Optimality of Universal Bayesian Sequence Prediction for General Loss and Alphabet
sources.reported_result: Exact mixture dominance gives prior-dependent loss/convergence bounds.
sources.assumptions: Normalized models and positive prior; convergence-to-truth requires supported truth or explicit misspecification bounds.
sources.claim_ceiling: Does not prove useful control or that an LLM interpreter implements the mixture. Report derives shared-action path inequality separately.

sources.title: Interventional Causal Representation Learning
sources.authors: Kartik Ahuja; Divyat Mahajan; Yixin Wang; Yoshua Bengio
sources.reported_result: Under specified observational and hard-intervention data, the intervened latent coordinate is identified up to shift and scaling.
sources.assumptions: Full-column-rank polynomial decoder, support interior, reconstruction/noncollapse and intervention-output constraints.
sources.claim_ceiling: Not general latent graph or natural-language referent identification; diffeomorphism extension needs more interventions.

sources.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach
sources.reported_result: LLM semantic structural priors are combined with conditional-independence evidence using Causal ABA.
sources.assumptions: Causal graph/CI assumptions; elicited priors are imperfect; some metadata generated from ground-truth graph.
sources.claim_ceiling: Symbolic constraint-to-graph correspondence is not truth of LLM constraints; bad priors can hurt.

sources.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
sources.reported_result: Long-context baselines remain strong; memory revision is harder than retention in tested systems.
sources.assumptions: Specified tasks, models, context and memory methods; not universal ranking.
sources.claim_ceiling: A memory or KG structure alone does not establish useful persistent learning.

sources.title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
sources.read_depth: Primary ACL paper methods and reported experiments
sources.reported_result: LLM predicts language state transitions and proposes actions in an MCTS planning construction.
sources.assumptions: Task-specific state/action/reward and planner; self-generated rollouts.
sources.claim_ceiling: No guarantee those rollouts match an external environment, nor continuous or fractal learning.

bridges.name: LLM이 해석하고 실행하는 관계 의미
bridges.remaining: Construct an actual LLM relation interpreter and grounded observation/action contract; measure model/context-dependent error.

bridges.name: 의미 prior를 활용한 관계 후보 탐색
bridges.remaining: Demonstrate useful LLM-generated hypotheses under equal-information/equal-resource baselines and fresh evaluation; no exhaustive-answer leakage.

bridges.remaining: Implement a declared outcome update and identifying intervention family; separate predictive fit, causal attribution and fresh utility.

bridges.name: 지속되는 의미 revision과 world/self 상태
bridges.remaining: Show revisions alter fresh execution and preserve exceptions, uncertainty, provenance and learned self/world readouts.

bridges.name: LLM 셀 합성의 공동 전이와 학습 보존
bridges.remaining: Construct joint Step/Learn preservation with shared causes, uncertainty, delays, costs, rights and bounded recursive gain.

analytical_derivations.name: Finite mixture path log-loss inequality
analytical_derivations.scope: Fixed supported models and positive prior, exact updating, non-anticipatory shared actions; no control or efficacy theorem.

analytical_derivations.name: Finite joint-trace coupling inequality
analytical_derivations.source: Existing Step/Learn quotient scope and elementary finite maximal coupling
analytical_derivations.scope: Uniform per-common-prefix joint-kernel TV bound including learning; no inference from child marginals.

external_anchor_bindings.name: CR-0: Concrete Step/Learn semantics and safety
CR-3: Causal multiscale credit without double counting
CR-4: Useful coalition and topology construction/recovery
CR-5: Joint world/self prediction and diachronic continuity
CR-6: Concrete composition, intervention and effect preservation
CR-7: One simultaneous witness, runtime refinement and external validity
HSWM Semantic Weight: current theoretical foundation and discovery

review: LLM is execution/meaning engine, not proposal-only sidecar.
Ahuja claim narrowed to intervened coordinate under named observation/intervention/decoder constraints.
Causal ABA correspondence separated from truth and from a new theorem in Li–Russo.
Adaptive-action and positive log-probability premises made explicit.
Coupling bound applies to joint kernels on every common prefix.
